name: diag_t02_raw10_smoke_plan_02
command:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
n='diag_t02_raw10_smoke_plan_02'
p=Path('configs/t02_raw10_smoke_01.json');d=json.loads(p.read_text())
old='t02_rejected_raw_smoke_01';new='t02_export_raw10_smoke_01'
assert not list(Path('logs/pbs').glob(old+'-*')) and not list(Path('logs/pbs').glob(new+'-*'))
cmd=d['command'];assert cmd.count(old)==1;cmd=[new if x==old else x for x in cmd];d['command']=cmd
d['previous_plan']={'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
d['correction']='Only run-name prefix corrected to original submitter T02 rule; first attempt had no PBS receipt'
out=Path('configs/t02_raw10_smoke_02.json')
with out.open('x') as f:json.dump(d,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
out.chmod(0o444)
metrics={'command':cmd,'configuration':{'file':str(out),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'GPU_submitted':False,'scientific_parameters_unchanged':True}
Path('results',n+'.json').write_text(json.dumps({'metrics':metrics,'config':{'name':n,'scope':d['correction']}},indent=2));print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics),flush=True)
